no_adcom_quote.quote: This NDA was not presented at a meeting of the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee because there were no issues that needed discussion. The benefit risk assessment is straightforward and clearly favorable for the indicated population.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for ZYTIGA (abiraterone acetate, NDA202379). The FDA review documents (Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, and Division Director Memo) all state that the application was not presented to the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee (ODAC) because the pivotal trial COU-AA-301 used overall survival as a robust primary endpoint and the benefit-risk assessment was straightforward and clearly favorable, leaving no controversial issues requiring ODAC discussion. Because no AdComm was held, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
